question: Why were valid Sentinel certificates containing fitted numerical models not byte-reproducible across hosts, and what deterministic certification contract makes them so?

rootCause.exp: V8 evaluates Math.exp with a C++ port of fdlibm. Clang contracts a*b+c in it into fused multiply-add on arm64 but not on x86-64; results differ by 1 ULP on ~0.05% of inputs; full-batch gradient descent turns that into coefficient differences of up to hundreds of ULP, hence different model and certificate hashes.
rootCause.pow: From V8 14 (Node >= 25) `**` / Math.pow call the C library std::pow (use_std_math_pow, default on); V8 12 (Node 22) uses fdlibm pow. The D-SYM temperature grid therefore depends on the Node major version, not only on the CPU.
rootCause.certificationDesign: Stage 3F.6-C onwards let engine-approximated Math.exp / `**` results reach certificate digests, contrary to the Stage 2G determinism doctrine (src/experts/expert-contract.js), and no certificate recorded the platform.
rootCause.notCauses: Summation order, iteration order, object-key order, candidate order, stopping rules, JSON serialisation and hashing are fixed-order and exact: mean/standardisation vectors and all corpora reproduce bit for bit on every host.

experiments.exp: Stored fitted-model hashes are reproduced bit for bit by fdlibm exp evaluated with fused multiply-add, and by nothing else tested.
experiments.pow: The stored D-SYM temperature grid is reproduced by correctly rounded pow; fdlibm pow (V8 <= 13) does not reproduce it.

tolerances.rule: coefficientRelative = largest power of ten <= sqrt(observed platform noise * smallest decision-relevant perturbation); outputAbsolute = smallest power of ten >= the largest score / probability / metric shift the sensitivity study measured at that coefficient perturbation.
tolerances.usedFor: LEVEL_B classification of host-native runs only. No tolerance was used to accept any certificate.

requiredLevel.note: Every class keeps the byte-level requirement it had; it is strengthened from "on the certifying host" to "on every host", by computing under SENTINEL_CANONICAL_NUMERICS_V1. Level B and Level A are diagnostic comparisons for runs under host-native numerics; they never certify.

recordProfile.reason: certified under V8 <= 13 (fdlibm pow); canonical correctly rounded pow differs by 1 ULP in one temperature-grid cross-entropy

freshClone.environment: Node.js >= 20 and git; full chains recorded on Node 22 and 26 (linux-x64), Node 20 golden vectors / tests / D-SYM freeze only. No network, no hidden local state; build/ holds only derived output.

platformMatrixLimitation: Physical hosts available: linux-x64 only. Full chains ran on Node 22 (fresh GitHub clone, evidence regenerated from nothing) and Node 26; a Node 20 chain was interrupted by a container restart and is not recorded (Node 20 golden vectors, tests and a direct D-SYM freeze reproduction passed). The arm64 arithmetic of record is reproduced by exact emulation (fused fdlibm exp) and verified against every stored hash; no arm64 or macOS host was run.
